Democratic Choice (, OD) is a center-left political party in the Dominican Republic,founded in 2015 by Minou Tavárez Mirabal and other volunteers.
History
Democratic Choice (OD) was announced as a result of Mirabal's split from the Dominican Liberation’s Party in a public letter to the media.
Definitions
Democratic Choice is a party of Dominican citizens which claims to be without restrictions based on socioeconomic status, religious beliefs, ethnicity, gender, or any other condition. The party’s central focus is the construction of an able democratic society to exhibit humanity's highest aspirations and to satisfy the spiritual needs and materials of the Dominican people in a setting of fraternity, freedom, and justice.
Logo of the party
The logo of the party is a flower made up of the letters O and D. The logo's colors are blue, yellow, green, and red.
